# COGAI

> Cognitive health, measured. Two products with one clinical boundary. COGAI Workforce for employers. COGAI Medical for clinics and insurance plans. The employer never sees an individual score.

COGAI runs validated mental health screeners (PHQ 9, GAD 7, PCL 5, DAST 10, AUDIT, PSQI, Work Wellness) on a monthly cadence and sorts a population by a single composite risk number called the R Score. The platform was built on top of Cognifica Health, an active clinical practice founded by Dr. John Abrahams in Aquebogue and West Harrison, New York.

The clinical boundary is the architecture. Employers receive aggregate only reporting under a minimum cohort floor. Plans receive aggregate and HEDIS measures. Identity does not flow to the employer or plan absent explicit consent. AI is not used for diagnosis, is not for emergency response, and clinical decisions are always initiated by a human.

## Products

- [COGAI Workforce](https://www.cogai.health/workforce): Workplace mental health for employers. Seven validated instruments on the employee's phone every month. One composite R Score. The employer never sees an individual score. Aggregate insight for HR. Confidential for the employee.
- [COGAI Medical](https://www.cogai.health/medical): Population mental health for clinics and insurance plans. Validated screeners on a monthly cadence. Twelve month trend per patient. Crisis flags surfaced in real time. Per seat for clinics. Per patient per month for insurance plans.

## How it works

- [How COGAI works](https://www.cogai.health/how-it-works): Validated instruments, R Score risk stratification, three role views, crisis protocol, and the AI posture in detail.
- [Privacy architecture](https://www.cogai.health/privacy): Consent first. Architecture, not policy. Three contractual commitments and the consent document.

## Get started

- [Start your free trial](https://www.cogai.health/workforce#demo): Free six month trial of COGAI Workforce for organizations with 50 to 2,200 employees. One full measurement cycle every month. Readout sessions at Day 1, month 3, and month 6. No credit card. No commitment to convert.

## Crisis resources

If you or someone you know is in crisis, call or text 988 (the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline in the United States), or text HOME to 741741 (Crisis Text Line). COGAI is not a crisis service.
